claims.text: POL-NS-01(c) makes the fee chargeable only if the driver 'held position inside' the arrival geofence for a continuous dwell of at least 300 seconds for this LARGE_VENUE pickup. The record never shows a 300-second continuous hold. The driver's two qualifying holds are 170 seconds (18:44:45 to 18:47:35) and 185 seconds (18:49:35 to 18:52:40), separated by a 120-second excursion in which he left the 120 m arrival radius and reached 179.0 m from the pin. The longest continuous run is 185 seconds, 115 seconds short of the minimum, so limb (c) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

The only route to 300 seconds is to add the two short holds together under POL-NS-06(i), and that limb applies only where the advisory made 'holding position ... not lawfully possible'. The trace shows the driver holding the very kerbside bay the advisory is said to cover continuously for 185 seconds, and his own message at 18:47:50 records a self-chosen loop ('i go one round and come back', MSG-00214-004), not an enforced removal; the premise of the exception is not made out. In any event POL-NS-06(i) is a qualification on the POL-NS-06 refund computation and does not enlarge the continuous-dwell condition in POL-NS-01(c); the exception must be construed strictly and cannot convert two sub-minimum holds into the continuous 300-second dwell the clause demands.

The driver cannot answer the shortfall with the rider's whereabouts. POL-NS-06 makes the dwell test decisive 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and the chat log shows the rider did respond and coordinate ('ok coming down now', MSG-00214-003, 18:46:20). On the raw trace the effective continuous dwell is 185 seconds against a 300-second minimum, so POL-NS-06 directs a full refund of the SGD 4.00 and no driver compensation is payable.

If the applicability of POL-NS-06(i) is genuinely open on this record, the fact that decides the charge is unresolved and the case falls to be escalated under POL-NS-09 rather than decided by the automated pipeline. Escalation is terminal and, unlike a ruling on the merits, leaves the disputed SGD 4.00 held rather than collected or refunded, so the rider is not left carrying the charge while the question — whether a kerb restriction that the trace shows him holding for 185 continuous seconds really made holding 'not lawfully possible' — is settled by a human reviewer.

claims.text: The arrival test is satisfied on the driver's own trace: 40 qualifying in-geofence fixes fall within the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, the first of them at 18:44:45, and the trip_record carries an 'arrived' event at 18:44:30 with the pickup pinned at ION Orchard's registered PHV bay. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) therefore hold, and POL-NS-02's proximity test is passed rather than failed.

The effective dwell exceeds the minimum. The trace shows two stationary holds — 170 seconds running from 18:44:45 and 185 seconds running from 18:49:35 — separated by a single loop during which the driver never went further than 179.0 m from the pin, comfortably inside the 300 m leash. EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is a populated LTA KERB_RESTRICTION whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose 17:00-20:00 window covers the whole waiting period, so holding position was not lawfully possible and POL-NS-06(i) permits the two in-geofence intervals to be summed. Accumulated dwell is 355 seconds against the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum — a surplus of 55 seconds, not a shortfall.

Termination satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (d): the driver cancelled at 18:52:45 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, five seconds after the second hold ended at 18:52:40 — that is, at or after the moment the accumulated dwell requirement elapsed. No boarding event is recorded anywhere in the trip record, so the trip was correctly terminated by the driver on a no-show basis rather than the driver admitting he could not locate the rider.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record. Limb (b) fails first: the rider wrote 'ok coming down now' at 18:46:20 and the driver replied at 18:47:50, 90 seconds later — inside the 120 second window — and at any rate the rider's 18:46:20 message is a status statement, not a locating message giving an entrance, block, tower or bay. Limb (c) is also affirmatively failed: the rider's device never came closer than 690.7 m to the pickup pin against the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius, and there are zero rider qualifying fixes.

There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. At the 18:44:30 marker the driver's track shows stationary speeds — 0.0 kph appears among the distinct speeds — and the first qualifying in-geofence fix follows only 15 seconds later at 18:44:45. The marker is neither more than 300 m from the pin nor taken while travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the waiting clock runs from the arrival event and nothing is recomputed against the driver.

No wrong-entrance case arises under POL-NS-03 and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is owed to anyone. The pickup zone has a single registered pickup point, so POL-NS-03(ii)'s two-or-more-points precondition is absent, and the driver's stationary fixes fall inside the 120 m arrival radius — so the clause's premise, a driver stationary outside that radius but within 400 m, is simply not met.

The chat log corroborates the driver rather than the rider's account of a car wandering about. At 18:45:10 the driver gave the exact bay and vehicle ('im at the ION PHV bay along Orchard Turn, white Vios'); at 18:47:50, on the marshal's instruction, he told the rider in terms that he was going one round and returning to the same place — which matches the trace's single 18:47:35-18:49:35 loop and his prompt return to the same kerb. That is a driver managing a kerbside restriction, not a driver abandoning the pickup.

The $4.00 charged is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces: the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), which agree here. The fare_breakdown cancellation_fee reconciles with that figure, so the fare line is not defective and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

Compensation is payable to the driver under POL-NS-07 because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and measured against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 118 the ratio is 0.017, far below 0.08. The driver is therefore owed 80 percent of the fee — SGD 3.20 — with the fee itself standing.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the abuse threshold of 3; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so there is no repeat-pair pattern; and every artifact in the bundle is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issue codes fired, so no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.20, being 80% of that fee under POL-NS-07. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and the figure 3.20 sits in both money fields because POL-GEN-03 requires it on a driver-compensation ruling; it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider, whose charge stands.

The fee. The trip record shows the driver arrived at the ION Orchard PHV bay at 18:44:30 and cancelled at 18:52:45 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace is complete (100% coverage, no gaps, weight 1.0) and contains 40 qualifying in-radius fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) hold. Limb (d) holds: the driver terminated the trip on a no-show code at 18:52:45, with no boarding event recorded anywhere.

The dwell, which is the point the rider argues. The rider is right about the raw arithmetic: no single continuous hold reaches 300 seconds. The two holds are 170 s (18:44:45 to 18:47:35) and 185 s (18:49:35 to 18:52:40), and the longest is 185 s. But POL-NS-06(i) is the rule this policy gives for how that dwell limb is measured where a kerb restriction is in force: it permits separate in-geofence intervals within one pickup attempt to be summed, provided the driver never went more than 300 m from the pin and a qualifying advisory covered the road and the waiting window. Both conditions are met. The driver's furthest point during the 18:47:35 to 18:49:35 loop was 179.0 m, inside the 300 m leash, and EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is a populated LTA KERB_RESTRICTION (full-day bus lane, no stopping, waiting or picking up, 17:00 to 20:00 on Orchard Turn) whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the whole waiting period. The rider's contrary argument, that the exception cannot apply because the driver was able to hold the kerb for 185 s and that POL-NS-06(i) cannot enlarge the word 'continuous' in POL-NS-01(c), is rejected: POL-NS-06(i) is precisely the provision that states whether separate stretches are summed, and the advisory's own terms (vehicles holding the kerb will be moved on) together with the driver's 18:47:50 message that the marshal moved him on show that holding position was not lawfully possible. Accumulated dwell is 355 seconds against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, a surplus of 55 seconds, so POL-NS-06 does not displace the charge.

Other clauses. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: the zone has one registered pickup point, so the pin-ambiguity precondition is absent, and the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius rather than outside it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the driver replied at 18:47:50, 90 seconds after the rider's 18:46:20 message, inside the 120-second window, and limb (c) is affirmatively failed because the rider's device never came closer than about 690 m to the pin (zero qualifying rider fixes) against the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the 18:44:30 marker the driver was not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the marker is not false and the waiting clock is not recomputed against him. POL-NS-08 is not engaged: the 4.00 fee equals the greater of the 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee, and every artifact in the bundle is COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

Driver compensation and escalation. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the 4.00 fee, 3.20, with the residual 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2 of 118 completed trips is 0.017 (below 0.08). No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so there is no repeat-pair pattern; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. The rider's request for escalation is therefore refused, because the applicability of POL-NS-06(i) is not genuinely open on this record. No referral fires: POL-NS-05(ii) has no application because the arrival marker is not false.

Confidence. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact, the GPS trace, the trip record, the traffic advisory, the fare breakdown and the driver profile, carries weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.90. No context-only profile field (rating, account_age_days, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, prior_no_show_flags and the like) was used as a ground of decision.

Outcome: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 compensation (80% of the fee under POL-NS-07). amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd because on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the amount field carries the same figure the ruling moves, not a rider refund (POL-GEN-03).

DRIVER — accepted. Arrival and dwell are verified on your own trace and record. EV-GPS-00214 (weight 1.0) places you inside the 120 m ION Orchard arrival radius from 18:44:45, 15 s after the EV-TRIP-00214 (weight 1.0) 'arrived' marker at 18:44:30, and the trip is terminated by you at 18:52:45 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (d) hold. On dwell, the trace shows two in-geofence holds — 170 s (18:44:45–18:47:35) and 185 s (18:49:35–18:52:40) — separated by a single loop in which you stayed 179 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash. EV-ADVIS-00214-01 (weight 1.0) is a populated LTA KERB_RESTRICTION (full-day bus lane, Orchard Turn, 17:00–20:00, marshals active, vehicles holding the kerb moved on) whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose window covers the whole waiting period. POL-NS-06(i) therefore permits the two intervals to be summed: accumulated dwell is 355 s against the 300 s LARGE_VENUE minimum, a 55 s surplus, not a shortfall. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (you were stationary at the marker, first qualifying fix 15 s later, never at 15 km/h). No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge: POL-NS-03 fails because the zone has a single registered pickup point and your stationary fixes are inside the 120 m radius; POL-NS-04 fails because you replied within 120 s and the rider's device never came within 690 m of the pin; POL-NS-06 does not fire because there is no shortfall. The SDG 4.00 line reconciles exactly with fee_schedule.resolution_rule — the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee (4.00) — so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. POL-NS-07 is satisfied: the anti-farming check reads only no_show_terminations_30d (2, below 4) against completed_trips_30d (118, ratio 0.017, below 0.08), so the 20% retention does not apply and you receive 3.20.

RIDER — your points are answered together and rejected. The five-minute minimum is not required to be one unbroken stand where a kerb restriction made holding unlawful: deciding the limb applies the rule another clause gives about it, and POL-NS-06(i) expressly allows separate stretches to be summed on exactly this advisory. The effective dwell is 355 s, so the shortfall case in POL-NS-06 never arises and the rider's whereabouts (properly, that the rider was not present) is beside the point. There is nothing genuinely open to escalate: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other, disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides, no_show_disputes_30d is 1, the anti-farming check is clear, and every artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so POL-NS-09(a)–(e) are all unmet and the platform-wide 0.70 floor is not approached. Your account of a car wandering about is not supported: the chat log and the trace show one enforced loop off the kerb with a return to the same bay.

All bundle artifacts carry weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes, so no POL-GEN-02 discount applies and the ruling rests on evidence at full weight. The driver's counterparty statement carries no weight multiplier and is read as context only. No clause produces a referral (POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival record, POL-RD-06(c) and POL-RD-09(4) are all inapplicable), so referrals is empty.

To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands, and the platform pays the driver SGD 3.20.

What the record shows. The driver accepted at 18:39:05, the trip record records arrival at the ION Orchard PHV bay at 18:44:30, and he cancelled at 18:52:45 with reason RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace is unbroken 10-second telemetry at 100% coverage and shows two stationary holds at the bay — 170 seconds from 18:44:45 and 185 seconds from 18:49:35 — separated by one 120-second loop on which he never went further than 179 m from the pin. POL-NS-02's proximity test is passed (40 qualifying in-radius fixes within the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius), so the dispute turns on dwell.

Rider's case, rejected. POL-NS-01(c)'s minimum dwell for a LARGE_VENUE pickup is 300 seconds, and the rider is right that no single hold reaches it (the longest is 185 seconds). But POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals within one pickup attempt to be summed where the driver left and re-entered the arrival radius without ever exceeding 300 m from the pin, AND a traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION covers the pickup road and the waiting period. Both conditions hold: EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is a live LTA bus-lane/kerb restriction (KERB_RESTRICTION) whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose 17:00-20:00 window covers the whole 18:38-18:52 wait, and the driver's furthest point on the loop was 179 m, inside the 300 m leash. The rider's point that the exception's premise ('holding position was not lawfully possible') is not made out because he held the kerb for 185 seconds fails: the advisory is present, populated and in force, and the driver's own in-app message at 18:47:50 — 'boss the marshal make me move, bus lane until 8pm. i go one round and come back same place ah' — records the enforced removal, matching the single loop. Accumulated dwell is 355 seconds against the 300-second minimum: a surplus of 55 seconds, not a shortfall. POL-NS-06 does not refund the fee, and the rider's reading of POL-NS-06(i) as confined to the refund computation would make POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 yield opposite results on the same number; the accumulation rule governs the effective dwell. The rider's request to escalate the interpretation is refused: an open interpretive question is not a POL-NS-09 trigger and is not a referral.

Other clauses checked. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the driver replied 90 seconds after her 18:46:20 message (inside the 120-second window), and her device never came closer than 690.7 m to the pin against a 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius. POL-NS-05 finds no false arrival marker — at 18:44:30 the driver was stationary at the bay. POL-NS-03 does not arise: the zone has one registered pickup point and the stationary fixes are inside the 120 m arrival radius. POL-NS-08 is not engaged: every artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, the fee reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee), the chat has no gaps, and the trace has no sampling gap.

Compensation. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 applies: 80% of the SGD 4.00 fee is SGD 3.20, with the residual SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/118 = 0.017 (below 0.08) — so compensation is paid. The SGD 4.00 charge stands; the platform pays the SGD 3.20.

No escalation and no referral. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the repeat-pair and abuse counters are below their thresholds (no_show_disputes_30d = 1, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0); and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. No clause produces a referral. Confidence rests on EV-GPS-00214 and EV-ADVIS-00214-01, both at weight 1.0.

ruling.explanation:
Both accounts are tested against the trace and the policy, and the deciding facts are these. The driver reached the ION Orchard PHV bay at 18:44:30 and the trace places him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius for 40 qualifying fixes, so arrival under POL-NS-02 is established. The trace then shows two stationary holds — 170 seconds from 18:44:45 to 18:47:35 and 185 seconds from 18:49:35 to 18:52:40 — separated by a single two-minute loop (18:47:35–18:49:35) in which the driver never went further than 179 m from the pin, comfortably inside the 300 m leash. EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is a populated LTA KERB_RESTRICTION whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose 17:00–20:00 window covers the whole waiting period, so holding at the kerb was not lawfully possible and POL-NS-06(i) permits the two in-geofence intervals to be added. The effective dwell is 355 seconds against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum — a surplus of 55 seconds, not a shortfall.

On the rider's points. (1) The argument that POL-NS-01(c) requires one unbroken 300-second hold is not accepted: POL-NS-06(i) expressly allows separate in-geofence intervals within a single pickup attempt to be summed where a kerb restriction is in force, and the effective dwell is the summed figure of 355 seconds. The longest continuous run (185 seconds) is not the test once limb (i) applies. (2) The argument that the loop was the driver's own choice rather than an enforced removal is not accepted: the clause requires the advisory to be present and populated with the right type, geometry and window, which it is, and the driver's contemporaneous message at 18:47:50 (MSG-00214-004, 'the marshal make me move, bus lane until 8pm') matches the single loop in the trace and his prompt return to the same bay. (3) The request to escalate under POL-NS-09 is refused: none of its triggers is present — no POL-NS-08 impairment, no direct conflict between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence, no repeat-pair history (both counterparty counters are 0), no anti-farming trip and a rider 30-day no-show count of 1, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The applicability of POL-NS-06(i) is not genuinely open.

Other checks. POL-NS-05: no false arrival marker — at the 18:44:30 marker the driver was stationary and well within 300 m. POL-NS-03: no wrong-entrance case — the driver's stationary fixes fall inside the arrival radius and the zone has a single registered pickup point, so the clause's premise is absent. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the rider's 18:46:20 message was answered by the driver at 18:47:50, 90 seconds later and inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) fails, and limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes (the rider's device never came closer than 690.7 m to the pin against a 150 m radius, with zero qualifying rider fixes). POL-NS-08: no limb is engaged — no clock skew (marker 15 seconds from the nearest fix), 100 per cent coverage with no gap, five chat messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count, and the $4.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the $4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the $4.00 RYDE_X tier fee. Every artifact carries weight 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02 discount applies.

Outcome. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full ((a) arrived event, (b) 40 qualifying in-radius fixes, (c) effective dwell 355 s ≥ 300 s, (d) cancelled at 18:52:45 on RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event and after the dwell elapsed) and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The $4.00 cancellation fee therefore stands, and under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 per cent of it: $3.20 of $4.00. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2 of 118 completed trips is 0.017 (below 0.08). The emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION because compensation is paid, with amount_sgd carrying the same $3.20 figure as driver_compensation_sgd, the fee itself being left in place; the only profile fields used are the two POL-NS-07 names.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-01(c) makes the fee chargeable only if the driver 'held position inside' the arrival geofence for a continuous dwell of at least 300 seconds for this LARGE_VENUE pickup. The record never shows a 300-second continuous hold. The driver's two qualifying holds are 170 seconds (18:44:45 to 18:47:35) and 185 seconds (18:49:35 to 18:52:40), separated by a 120-second excursion in which he left the 120 m arrival radius and reached 179.0 m from the pin. The longest continuous run is 185 seconds, 115 seconds short of the minimum, so limb (c) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

The only route to 300 seconds is to add the two short holds together under POL-NS-06(i), and that limb applies only where the advisory made 'holding position ... not lawfully possible'. The trace shows the driver holding the very kerbside bay the advisory is said to cover continuously for 185 seconds, and his own message at 18:47:50 records a self-chosen loop ('i go one round and come back', MSG-00214-004), not an enforced removal; the premise of the exception is not made out. In any event POL-NS-06(i) is a qualification on the POL-NS-06 refund computation and does not enlarge the continuous-dwell condition in POL-NS-01(c); the exception must be construed strictly and cannot convert two sub-minimum holds into the continuous 300-second dwell the clause demands.

The driver cannot answer the shortfall with the rider's whereabouts. POL-NS-06 makes the dwell test decisive 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages', and the chat log shows the rider did respond and coordinate ('ok coming down now', MSG-00214-003, 18:46:20). On the raw trace the effective continuous dwell is 185 seconds against a 300-second minimum, so POL-NS-06 directs a full refund of the SGD 4.00 and no driver compensation is payable.

If the applicability of POL-NS-06(i) is genuinely open on this record, the fact that decides the charge is unresolved and the case falls to be escalated under POL-NS-09 rather than decided by the automated pipeline. Escalation is terminal and, unlike a ruling on the merits, leaves the disputed SGD 4.00 held rather than collected or refunded, so the rider is not left carrying the charge while the question — whether a kerb restriction that the trace shows him holding for 185 continuous seconds really made holding 'not lawfully possible' — is settled by a human reviewer.

The arrival test is satisfied on the driver's own trace: 40 qualifying in-geofence fixes fall within the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, the first of them at 18:44:45, and the trip_record carries an 'arrived' event at 18:44:30 with the pickup pinned at ION Orchard's registered PHV bay. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) therefore hold, and POL-NS-02's proximity test is passed rather than failed.

The effective dwell exceeds the minimum. The trace shows two stationary holds — 170 seconds running from 18:44:45 and 185 seconds running from 18:49:35 — separated by a single loop during which the driver never went further than 179.0 m from the pin, comfortably inside the 300 m leash. EV-ADVIS-00214-01 is a populated LTA KERB_RESTRICTION whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose 17:00-20:00 window covers the whole waiting period, so holding position was not lawfully possible and POL-NS-06(i) permits the two in-geofence intervals to be summed. Accumulated dwell is 355 seconds against the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum — a surplus of 55 seconds, not a shortfall.

Termination satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (d): the driver cancelled at 18:52:45 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, five seconds after the second hold ended at 18:52:40 — that is, at or after the moment the accumulated dwell requirement elapsed. No boarding event is recorded anywhere in the trip record, so the trip was correctly terminated by the driver on a no-show basis rather than the driver admitting he could not locate the rider.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this record. Limb (b) fails first: the rider wrote 'ok coming down now' at 18:46:20 and the driver replied at 18:47:50, 90 seconds later — inside the 120 second window — and at any rate the rider's 18:46:20 message is a status statement, not a locating message giving an entrance, block, tower or bay. Limb (c) is also affirmatively failed: the rider's device never came closer than 690.7 m to the pickup pin against the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius, and there are zero rider qualifying fixes.

There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. At the 18:44:30 marker the driver's track shows stationary speeds — 0.0 kph appears among the distinct speeds — and the first qualifying in-geofence fix follows only 15 seconds later at 18:44:45. The marker is neither more than 300 m from the pin nor taken while travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the waiting clock runs from the arrival event and nothing is recomputed against the driver.

No wrong-entrance case arises under POL-NS-03 and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is owed to anyone. The pickup zone has a single registered pickup point, so POL-NS-03(ii)'s two-or-more-points precondition is absent, and the driver's stationary fixes fall inside the 120 m arrival radius — so the clause's premise, a driver stationary outside that radius but within 400 m, is simply not met.

The chat log corroborates the driver rather than the rider's account of a car wandering about. At 18:45:10 the driver gave the exact bay and vehicle ('im at the ION PHV bay along Orchard Turn, white Vios'); at 18:47:50, on the marshal's instruction, he told the rider in terms that he was going one round and returning to the same place — which matches the trace's single 18:47:35-18:49:35 loop and his prompt return to the same kerb. That is a driver managing a kerbside restriction, not a driver abandoning the pickup.

The $4.00 charged is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces: the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), which agree here. The fare_breakdown cancellation_fee reconciles with that figure, so the fare line is not defective and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

Compensation is payable to the driver under POL-NS-07 because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and measured against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 118 the ratio is 0.017, far below 0.08. The driver is therefore owed 80 percent of the fee — SGD 3.20 — with the fee itself standing.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the abuse threshold of 3; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so there is no repeat-pair pattern; and every artifact in the bundle is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issue codes fired, so no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence.
